name: @battuta/plugin-formats
description: Everything battuta reads and writes beyond MEI: MusicXML (plain and zipped), ABC, Plaine & Easie and Humdrum in; written-score MIDI, Humdrum and PAE out — through Verovio's Humdrum-enabled build in the plugin's own worker.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.

dependencies: @battuta/api and verovio — the CONVERTER build only (verovio/wasm-hum + verovio/esm), which is this plugin's whole purpose. Engraving stays the host's render service; plugin-boundaries fails the build on a render or layout call, and src/verovio.d.ts does not even declare one. No react: this plugin renders nothing.
